summary: Examples gather and print service facts, filter existing systemd services, and restart a service only if it exists.
questions: How do I restart a service only if it's installed?
How do I list systemd services that actually exist?
How do I print all service facts?

answer_card.title: service_facts examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.service_facts:
- ansible.builtin.debug: {var: ansible_facts.services}
- ansible.builtin.service:
    name: ntpd.service
    state: restarted
  when: ansible_facts['services']['ntpd.service']['status'] | default('not-found') != 'not-found'
```
Filter real systemd units: `selectattr('source','equalto','systemd') | rejectattr('status','equalto','not-found')`.
